sections.heading: Before or After Your Delivery Order

blocks.html: Kenilworth, NJ, keeps things local in the best possible way. Kenilworth Boulevard draws residents in with a walkable stretch of independently owned restaurants, shops, and gathering spots that give the borough its distinct small-town character, while the surrounding green spaces offer a quieter counterpoint to all that activity. For weed delivery Kenilworth has come to rely on, Lady L makes it easy to keep your plans on your own terms, whether you'll be heading out to one of the borough's standout spots or chilling at home.

blocks.title: Galloping Hill Golf Course
blocks.html: Galloping Hill Golf Course covers 271 acres in Kenilworth and is widely regarded as one of the most challenging public courses in the region. The 18-hole layout underwent a major renovation in 2014 by renowned architect Rees Jones, restoring the course's original shot values and updating drainage throughout. The on-site Learning Center features 52 stalls and a 9-hole practice course, making it a destination for players of all skill levels.

blocks.title: Chat & Griddle
blocks.html: Chat & Griddle is a brunch and breakfast spot on Kenilworth Boulevard known for hand-crafted sandwiches, chicken and waffles, French toast, burgers, and all-day breakfast served in a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere. The menu covers a wide range of cravings from hearty morning plates to satisfying lunch options, with something to suit most tastes. It has earned a strong local following for consistent quality and a laid-back dining experience.

blocks.title: Black Brook Park
blocks.html: Black Brook Park on N 19th Street is one of 36 Union County parks and a well-used outdoor resource in Kenilworth. The park features baseball, soccer, and softball fields, along with fishing access, and the Black Brook Park Path connects directly to the East Coast Greenway, the long-distance trail network stretching from Maine to Florida. It's a solid everyday green space with recreational depth that goes beyond what its footprint might suggest.

blocks.title: Kenilworth Diner
blocks.html: The Kenilworth Diner has been serving the borough for over 40 years with fresh, homestyle cooking and the kind of attentive service that turns first-time visitors into regulars. The menu covers fresh soups, hearty entrees, and an award-winning cheesecake that has earned a following well beyond Kenilworth's borders. An expanded catering menu rounds out an operation that has grown steadily without losing the warmth that built its reputation.

blocks.title: Ava's Kitchen and Bar
blocks.html: Tucked just off Kenilworth Boulevard, Ava's Kitchen and Bar is a neighborhood spot built around a wood-burning brick oven and a genuine commitment to the craft of pizza-making. The kitchen uses sourdough starters, lengthy fermentations, stone-ground local flours, and seasonal ingredients to produce thin, crackly-crusted pies with a flavor profile that's hard to replicate. Beyond pizza, the bar offers 32 beers on tap, wines by the glass, and an extensive selection of craft spirits and cocktails.

blocks.title: Oswald J. Nitschke House
blocks.html: The Oswald J. Nitschke House is an 1880 wood-framed farmhouse and one of Kenilworth's most significant historic landmarks. Built by a German immigrant who served three terms as mayor and championed the borough's incorporation in 1907, the house was saved from demolition in 2003 when the Kenilworth Historical Society relocated it to prevent its loss to commercial development. Preserved and restored with support from the New Jersey Historic Trust, it serves as a living history museum and cultural arts center that reflects the immigrant influences and suburban development that shaped the borough's early character.

items.q: What’s the age requirement to receive cannabis delivery in Kenilworth?
items.a_html: In New Jersey, the law sets the adult-use minimum at 21, and that applies to every Lady L delivery order without exception. Your age is verified during account registration, and the driver will confirm your ID again upon arrival.

items.q: What ID do I need to show when my Lady L delivery arrives?
items.a_html: Government-issued photo ID is the standard across the board. Driver's licenses, state-issued identification cards, and passports all qualify, and unexpired out-of-state IDs are accepted without issue. You'll need to upload your ID to your Lady L account before placing your first order, and have the physical document ready when your driver shows up.

items.q: Does Lady L require a medical cannabis card for delivery?
items.a_html: Not at all. Lady L is a fully adult-use operation, open to any customer 21 or older. No referral, no card, no special status required. A confirmed account and a valid ID are the only things standing between you and a delivery order.

items.q: How much can I order in a single Kenilworth delivery?
items.a_html:
New Jersey law permits us to sell up to the equivalent of 28.35 grams, or one ounce, of usable cannabis per transaction. Here's how that breaks down across product types:

  • Dried Flower/Bud: 28.35 grams (1 ounce).
  • Concentrates/Resin/Oils: 4 grams (solid or liquid/vaporized oil).
  • Ingestible Items (Gummies/Edibles): 1,000 mg of THC (roughly ten 100mg packages).
  • Maximum Possession Limit: Up to 6 ounces of cannabis and cannabis products.
  • Mixing Products: You can mix and match, for example, by purchasing 1/2 ounce of flower and 2 grams of concentrates.
  • Daily Limits: The 1-ounce limit is generally considered a daily limit across all dispensaries.

items.q: What taxes apply to a Kenilworth cannabis delivery order?
items.a_html: Three taxes apply to adult-use cannabis in New Jersey: a 6.625% state sales tax, a $2.50-per-ounce Social Equity Excise Fee (SEEF), and a 2% municipal transfer or user tax where the local municipality has authorized it. All of them are broken out at checkout before your order is confirmed.
